label: DYNAMIC-PC-TOKEN-SVA
title: Repair elastic EX/MEM capture and dynamic-token invariants
dependency_override: Created from the failed T-009 candidate to resolve its P7-3 backpressure integration blocker before T-009 can complete.
scope: Repair the WB-backpressured empty-EX/MEM handshake exposed by the T-009 self-loop test. Branch flush and FP response capture must use an EX/MEM acceptance condition, not the stricter EX/MEM-to-WB advance condition; an FP response may never be captured while rsp_ready is low. Also correct the adjacent-pipeline invariant: architectural PC is not a dynamic instruction identity because a self-loop can legally place distinct instances of the same PC in adjacent stages. Retain FIFO token epoch+seq uniqueness checks and add a directed repeated-PC regression.

failure.observation: With commit_ready low, FP occupies MEM/WB and B . occupies EX/MEM. On release the branch enters MEM/WB fetch-wait; a younger FP response was captured into empty EX/MEM while rsp_ready=0, leaving the same epoch+seq in ID/EX and EX/MEM. The branch had also advanced while flush_id was suppressed by the stricter stall_wb gate.

forbidden_regions: assertion disable switches or expected-result weakening
validation: T-009 full L0-L2 restart on the repaired candidate
acceptance: Branch redirect and FP response capture fire exactly when an empty or advancing EX/MEM can accept; rsp_ready=0 cannot populate EX/MEM or duplicate a token. The self-loop backpressure test passes with repeated dynamic PCs, no assertion is globally disabled, and true same-token adjacency/duplicate commit remains asserted. T-011 must remain read-only until this core-file fix is integrated into its base.

review.summary: Repeated-PC token invariants, EX/MEM acceptance, and FP response/data-MMU overlap passed the exact T-013 L0-L2 union.

board_policy: No assembler, bitstream generation, JTAG, programming, power-on, or board test without explicit user permission.
